exposure: Standardized protocol for obtaining, processing, and storing human amniotic membranes (hAMs)
Freezing in a solution of culture medium plus 50% v/v glycerol
outcome: Conservation of structural and cellular characteristics of hAMs
Conservation of mechanical properties of hAMs
cohort: Human amniotic membranes (hAMs) were obtained from mothers with healthy, full-term, controlled pregnancies delivered by cesarean section.
finding: The developed protocol successfully obtained sterile human amniotic membranes (hAMs) with conserved epithelium, stroma, and amniotic cells, and the glycerol used in storage may enhance the membrane's mechanical adaptability.
